title: SLOW FRAME TOASTS ARE HEADLINES ONLY
why: UI critic, screen 22: the detail lines under RESOLUTION STEPPED DOWN and RUNNING SLOWLY read as explaining text over the map. Both toasts are now the headline alone.
now: The two slow-frame toasts show only their headline.
